name: desktop-pet-patti
description: Desktop Pet Patti — a macOS desktop pet that chats, sees your screen, runs local LLMs, and helps with your calendar, alarms, and files.

extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Patti uses Calendar to read your upcoming events and create new ones when you ask.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Patti looks at your screen so she can react to what you're working on (videos, code, games).
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Patti uses AppleScript to talk to Calendar on your behalf.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Patti can listen for voice input when you tap the microphone button.
